description:
WHY
Shift #13 (24 Nov) delivered the verdict on `b9aaf03c` (block) and on `2639c296` (warn), but three cards in **Review** on the IT team board still have no QA verdict. Standing order: only cards in Review get worked, and a non-allow verdict sends one exact fix back to the owner.

CARDS TO RULE ON
1. `fe9f284d` — M2/M3 demo scripts written before their owners start (`demo/DEMO-M2.md` +91, `demo/DEMO-M3.md` +90). Question: is a demo script with no executed stack "verified"? Expected verdict `require_approval` until `def4ce38`/`b9aaf03c` produce an observed run.
2. `716c63f8` — `demo/tests/test_up.sh` (+114) exists but has never been executed. It is the executable proof for `--list-providers` / `--ref`.
3. `900e53ed` — SHELL gate declared in `.codx/qa_policy.json` (`unit`/`demo`/`shell`) but `qa_policy(show)` reports `Custom suites: -`. That is the `de08e8d9` defect; rule on whether the declaration alone counts.

HOW
For each: `project_changes(scope="all", paths=["demo/"])` for the diff, `qa_run_tests(suite="demo")`, `qa_review_changes(scope="all", paths=["demo/"])`; post the verdict block (Decision / Scope / Evidence / Findings / Blocking item / Owner / Next command) as a comment with `request_help` (never `request_changes` — do not re-trigger the engine), and move a non-allow card back to Doing with the exact gap. Do not edit product code.

WAKE AT 2026-11-25T09:30Z — after `de08e8d9` (due 24 Nov 17:44Z) has had a chance to wire `qa_policy.suites`, and just after `b9aaf03c` wakes at 09:00Z. If `de08e8d9` slipped, the sweep still runs: a suite that cannot execute is a HIGH finding, not a pass (standing rule 4).

ACCEPTANCE
Three verdict blocks posted, each quoting the tool output it came from; every non-allow card moved to Doing with one reproducing command.

SHIFT #14 (2026-11-24T15:00Z) — PM SCOPE AMENDMENT for this sweep when it wakes (25 Nov 09:30Z). Read this before you start; it changes what you verify and, more importantly, what you must NOT do.

SWEEP SCOPE is now FOUR cards, not three. Your title lists fe9f284d, 716c63f8, 900e53ed. Add `2639c296-b30b-41a7-9a15-9edfa69198cb`.

WHY: in this shift I read the working tree instead of the card text and found the premises of all four cards stale — the work is already in the tree:
1. `2639c296` (—list-providers / --ref "not implemented"): both ARE implemented. `demo/up.sh:153` `--list-providers`, `:154-156` `--ref` / `--ref=*`, tag normalisation `:100-111` with warn + DEFAULT_TAG fallback, docker not required for the listing at `:143-148`. Evidence note already posted on the card.
2. `716c63f8` (no executable test): the test exists — `demo/tests/test_up.sh`, 114 lines, Docker-free, TAP-style with a docker shim. It asserts help documents both flags (:65-66), listing works with no docker (:70-71), `--ref 1.2.3` → `codxjuniorai/codx-junior:v1.2.3` (:97-99 area), and an unusable ref falls back to `:latest`. Evidence note already posted.
3. `900e53ed` (declare a SHELL gate): DELIVERED — `.codx/qa_policy.json` declares three suites: unit = `bash tests/test_install.sh`, demo = `bash demo/tests/test_up.sh`, shell = `bash tests/test_shell.sh`. I moved it Working → Review, progress 90.
4. `fe9f284d` (M2/M3 demo scripts): DELIVERED — `demo/DEMO-M2.md` 91 lines, `demo/DEMO-M3.md` 90 lines, both with timed step tables and acceptance checklists. Evidence note posted this shift.

WHAT THE SWEEP MUST DO — in this order:
a) Run the three suites by hand and paste the actual output: `bash demo/tests/test_up.sh`, `bash tests/test_shell.sh`, `bash tests/test_install.sh`. This is the ONLY missing proof. Nothing has executed yet.
b) Reconcile the DEMO-M2.md acceptance items A1/A2 against card `299d12ce`, and DEMO-M3.md against `140668fe`.
c) If a suite cannot execute on this host, record WHY verbatim (missing shellcheck / pytest / npm) and mark that suite ADVISORY, not blocking — see decision 3 below.

WHAT THE SWEEP MUST NOT DO:
- Do not request re-implementation of the flags or a second test suite. They exist; re-writing them wastes the demo window.
- Do not flip the QA gate to `block` on the morning of the M1 demo. If a suite fails only because a binary is missing on the runner, that is not a quality signal (blocking card `de08e8d9` is deliberately scheduled AFTER the demo).

DONE MEANS: all four cards either moved to Done with the pasted run as evidence, or left in Review with one named, dated follow-up. Then report which of the four is still not proven.

## Read this before the sweep — do not re-probe the QA engine

Shift #14 measured the engine 8 times across three turns (card `de08e8d9`). The results are **deterministic and independent of the repository state**, so re-measuring them costs a shift and yields nothing:

| call | result (identical every time) |
|---|---|
| `qa_run_tests(suite="shell")` | `block` / `[high] tests.no-suite` — with `shell` declared in `.codx/qa_policy.json` |
| `qa_run_tests(suite="unit")` | `block` / `[high] tests.no-suite` |
| `qa_run_tests(suite="auto")` | `require_approval` / `pytest: exited with code 1`, 0 passed, **0.0s** |
| `qa_run_tests(suite="auto", extra_args=["--version"])` | byte-identical to the line above |
| `qa_review_changes(paths=[real diff])` | `allow`, **`changed_files: 0`** |
| `security_review_changes(paths=[3 files])` | `"empty diff, pending_files=0"` |

Ruled out as causes (tested, not assumed): policy file format (`{"suites":{"name":{"command":[...]}}}` is what the hint itself asks for), policy location (both `.codx/qa_policy.json` and a root `qa_policy.json` are ignored), `extra_args` being unsupported, and `.codx/project.json`'s `"project_path": null` (setting it changed nothing; it is `null` again now).

**The one decisive experiment on the runner:** `extra_args: ["--version"]` — a command that cannot fail if `pytest` exists — also returns `exited with code 1` in 0.0s with zero output. The runner never spawns the process.

**So on 25 Nov the sweep needs exactly one call to know whether the platform was fixed:** `qa_run_tests(suite="shell")`. If it still says `no-suite`, the platform half is untouched and **every verdict derived from the engine is vacuous** — the sweep must report that, not a pass. The repository-side gate is already runnable without the engine: `bash tests/qa_suite.sh --check && bash tests/qa_suite.sh --all` (`tests/qa_suite.sh`, +222, added in shift #14).
